function_specs.name: _SemaphoreDelete
function_specs.meaning: For a nonnegative ID, query the uint16-normalized handle, drain waiters if found, retire and release the same semaphore, and schedule exactly when there were waiters; preserve the reviewed critical protocol and abstract delete continuation.

new_predicates.name: delete_global_frame
new_predicates.meaning: The current os_inv resources outside the semaphore module, including its global consistency condition.
new_predicates.why_needed: ID deregistration and management-DLL deletion must preserve all other modules while the semaphore module is in an intermediate state.

new_predicates.name: delete_manager_frame
new_predicates.meaning: The concrete remainder after temporarily extracting the semaphore ID manager.
new_predicates.why_needed: The remainder must expose the management DLL after ID removal, so it cannot be hidden behind a wand requiring the old manager.

new_predicates.name: delete_pending_restore
new_predicates.meaning: A spatial continuation restoring the same os_inv after the read-only pending DLL is returned.
new_predicates.why_needed: IsDoubleLinkListEmpty borrows the list, while LinklistResumeAll requires the complete invariant.

new_predicates.name: delete_id_restore
new_predicates.meaning: A spatial continuation restoring os_inv after the semaphore ID field is returned unchanged.
new_predicates.why_needed: The IdRemoveObj argument is read before lending the complete manager to its contract.
